    I can work with you 1-on-1 to help you orient to a situation with some distrust or betrayal, or I can work live with a pair or group to notice where the collective trust-dance is getting stuck by trying to skip steps.
    
    This is relevant to communities, company dynamics, families, friends, and spiritual teacher-student relationships. I'd be particularly keen to mediate in teacher-student stuff, which seems like a good application for my NNTD framework and ideas I've been developing on co-gnosis.

    Mating-dance consulting.
    
    This is a specific application of trust-dancing to the process of falling in love. The basic premise is that there’s a process you can go through that, if it succeeds, will cause someone to feel like a life partner, but if your commitment exceeds where you are in the process, then things will feel off. I can help you sort out muddles and tangles there.

...which of course raises the question:

  what if Pay What You Want but good tho?

unlike sometimes when I ask this question, this isn't a hypothetical for me—I've been running PWYW-based life-clarifying workshops for years! here's how we approach it

our workshops often sell out, and it's important we don't get people showing up thinking it's "free". it's not free. it's pay what you want.

(we also offer a "you don't have to think about it" option!) https://t.co/cOz2fbFPnL

at the end of the workshop, we highlight 3 relevant dimensions:
 ‣ value you got
 ‣ your budget
 ‣ your desire to support our work & other people with less money being able to attend

and then encourage people to find an amount that feels good on all of those dimensions

  "whatever you put in, it's the right amount"

it wouldn't be worth it for us to keep running the workshops if *everybody* put in nothing, but that's just not what happens, so it doesn't really come up. we've never come close to that.
↓
1738387796451360862 [2023-12-23] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 3
the nature of these we're doing is that it scales quite well, and in a way that's quite low marginal cost

it's not ~zero marginal cost the way selling software or an ebook is, but one more participant at a workshop doesn't require more input from us
https://t.co/QhHw4SNDsa
  [Quoting @Malcolm_Ocean: the magic of the "coaching channel" ❤️‍🔥  how we do personalized coaching at scale in a way that's sometimes even better than 1-on-1 coaching]

1738387797566972069 [2023-12-23] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 2
so the tickets are $35

and then during the PWYW part at the end, we have people who put in $10 or $20, or even $3. and we appreciate that! it's still real money, some people are broke, and/or maybe the workshop was interesting but not life-changing
↓
1738387798569414934 [2023-12-23] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 2
and some people put in $100 or $200, or they look at what the "full price" ticket was and put in that much since it "met expectations"

and sometimes people put in $500 or $600! (I think that's the highest we've gotten so far)
↓
1738387799513170346 [2023-12-23] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 2
